products.name: Highbiza Webshop Software
products.description: The Highbiza webshop platform on Django, Django Oscar and Wagtail, sold in four packages: Launch (from EUR 149/month + from EUR 1,490 one-off), Core (from EUR 299 + 3,490), Prestige (from EUR 599 + 5,490) and Enterprise (from EUR 1,149, one-off on request).

products.name: Highbiza B2B Module
products.description: Customer-specific prices and assortments, staffels, quotes, reorder and customer portal; optional in Core, included from Prestige.

products.name: Highbiza Website Software
products.description: Wagtail-based websites and portals for trading companies and (semi-)public organisations, including WCAG 2.1 AA work for government.

products.name: Highbiza Integrations
products.description: Connectors to ERP (Exact Online, Business Central, Logic4, Vendit, Gripp, Prima, MediaMagic), payment providers, carriers (incl. DeliveryMatch) and marketplaces (EffectConnect, eBay, Google Shopping).

products.name: Highbiza Managed Platform Service
products.description: Hosting (dedicated in Enterprise), daily backups, automated updates and tests, test environments, support within one working day and quoted custom development.
